title: ADR-001 Evidence Acquisition and Recommendation are Separate Concerns
context: Initial prototype combined market-data fetching and recommendation in one scan pass, coupling recommendations to network availability and evidence freshness to ranking.
evidence_at_time: Prototype coupling observed.
rationale: Remove network dependency/coupling (as recorded in context).
expected_consequences: Instant regeneration on policy change; cache survives reloads/session transitions; ranking-mode change without provider calls; independently assessable evidence vs recommendation quality.
implementation: Evidence Acquisition makes provider calls and populates cache; Recommendation Engine reads cache only, zero provider calls.
subsequent: Reaffirmed as spine by ADR-018 and ADR-019 ('backend may durably record Decision context without becoming the evaluator'). Cache now backend SQLite + snapshot; browser cache role questioned by PL-PROV-FAILOVER 'no frontend shadow evidence database' (docs/parking-lot-3.md:236-238).
amendments: None in register. 'Cached evidence survives browser reloads' is in tension with later Principal direction that frontend caching is ordinary HTTP, not a shadow evidence DB (docs/parking-lot-3.md:236).
notes: Status 'Accepted'; acceptor not named in text — authority class inferred from register status.

title: ADR-002 Wheelwright as the Recommendation Craftsmanship Layer
context: Recommendation engine needed a domain identity distinct from Write Desk (UI) and Evidence Acquisition; 'Recommendation Lab' implied experimentation.
rationale: Represent precision/craftsmanship rather than experimentation.
expected_consequences: Internal naming buildWheelwrightBrief etc.; Write Desk is workbench, Wheelwright is craftsman; Wheelwright owns ranking, contract selection, execution assessment, brief building.
subsequent: 'Wheelwright' later became the name of the overall system/project (project-identity steering; ADR-012 'Wheelwright's primary home').
amendments: Effectively superseded in naming by project identity (Wheelwright = whole system) and ADR-012 retiring 'Write Desk'; PL-SHELL ratified 'Deployment' as canonical name (docs/parking-lot.md:31). No formal supersession recorded.
notes: Conflict: ADR text scopes 'Wheelwright' to the recommendation engine; later docs use it for the whole system. Status 'Accepted'; acceptor unnamed.

title: ADR-003 Recommendation Rank Independent of Presentation Sort
context: Column sorting raised whether changing sort should reset or recompute recommendation order.
expected_consequences: No auto-reset of user sort on policy change; Rank column always shows Wheelwright rank; UI communicates when view order differs.
implementation: Brief shows 'Recommendation #N' and 'Table Position #M (sorted by X)'.
subsequent: Cited by PL-EVID-AGE: Age is sortable presentation, not a rank input (docs/parking-lot-3.md:54).
notes: Status 'Accepted'; acceptor unnamed.

title: ADR-004 Broker Handoff via Pre-Populated Trade Ticket
context: Discovered Fidelity accepts externally constructed option trade-ticket URLs with pre-populated fields.
evidence_at_time: Fidelity URL fields ORDER_TYPE, ORDER_ACTION, LIMIT_STOP_PRICE, SECURITY_ID observed to work.
expected_consequences: Explicit execution boundary; operator verifies account/quantity/TIF/limit/contract; multiple broker adapters possible via same WriteIntent; portfolio never mutated by opening a link.
implementation: Broker-neutral WriteIntent → FidelityTradeLinkBuilder → new tab; system must not submit orders, interact with credentials, or assume acceptance.
subsequent: Broker modularity Principal requirement 2026-09-02 (docs/parking-lot.md:47); ADR-019 item 10 disposition is not execution; Fidelity collar order-shape finding (docs/parking-lot-6.md:195-203).
notes: Status 'Accepted'; acceptor unnamed.

amendments: Partially superseded in authority location by ADR-017 (docs/07c-adrs.md:648).

title: ADR-013 Position Monitoring Model (+ Resolution Outlook amendment)
context: Conventional single 'health' classification equates assignment with deterioration; assignment is an outcome, not a defect; composite score would violate Epistemic Integrity.
alternatives: single composite health score (rejected by reasoning)
rationale: Preserve fact-to-interpretation boundary.
expected_consequences: Three independent dimensions: Contract State (facts), Decision Pressure (interpretation of resolution proximity), Economic Consequence (arithmetic); 'health' not an architectural concept; ITM near expiration never a defect; situations consume but do not constrain.
implementation: DTE ladder; market-vs-effective-basis reconciliation for puts (Aug 2026 addition).
subsequent: Aug 2026 amendment adds Resolution Outlook → Production Outlook serving Operating Forecast (docs/07c-adrs.md:357-386); PL-UX-01 extends Decision Pressure toward exception/attention detection (docs/parking-lot.md:41); generalized by ADR-015.
amendments: Amended in place Aug 2026 (Resolution Outlook; put reconciliation measure).
notes: Explicit non-decisions: thresholds, state names, visual encoding, situation modification. Status 'Accepted'; acceptor unnamed.

title: ADR-014 Production Recognition and Current-Month Semantics
context: Current-month Production view exposed double-counting risk; needed rules for recognition, forecast vs known production, capital resolution vs deployable cash.
rationale: Prevent double counting and inflation by generic portfolio gains.
expected_consequences: Premium recognized at STO cash receipt exactly once; realized appreciation is Production only when causally attributable to governed lifecycle event (assignment of CC/BW), discretionary sale = PRINCIPAL_MOVEMENT; current-month operational vs historical reconciliatory; forecast exclusions invariant; 'resolving' not 'releasing'; production and erosion never netted.
implementation: ProductionAssessor routes ASSIGNED_CALL_STOCK_SALE vs ASSET_SALE; current-month-production.ts; 6 regression tests.
subsequent: Operating Forecast amendment (Aug 2026) in-ADR; PL-PROD-FORECAST V1 c6191db and PL-PROD-MISSION ce849bb implemented (docs/parking-lot.md:58-60); NSR (docs/parking-lot.md:59); Principal clarified prior-month Production is withdrawn (docs/parking-lot-6.md:179).
amendments: Forecast-semantics amendment Aug 2026 (docs/07c-adrs.md:425). Consequences 'Forecast shown as unavailable' and 'Mission shown as unavailable' are stale relative to later V1 implementations.
notes: Status 'Accepted'; acceptor unnamed.

title: ADR-016 Evidence-to-Domain Association Is an Authoritative Semantic Claim
context: Production Disposition Truth (#11/#3/#12): content fingerprint used as identity, OCC symbol as episode identity, locally-correct but globally unsafe matching, processing vs economic date, frontend reconstruction of associations.
evidence_at_time: Codex and Kiro converged independently on one principle across five layers.
alternatives: identity architecture as governing frame (explicitly not chosen; supporting observation only)
rationale: A token standing in for identity was asked to carry semantics it did not guarantee; missing was an authoritative statement of association.
expected_consequences: Owning interpretation layer owns association; UNRESOLVED legitimate; convenient identifiers gain no semantic authority; assessment-local uniqueness ≠ durable identity.
subsequent: PL-PROD-EXPORT-01 export semantics (docs/parking-lot-4.md); ADR-019/021/022 build on it; ADR-022 introduces bounded opaque cohort identity for governance acts.
notes: Normative non-decisions: no durable lifecycle identity, no UUID policy, no association framework, no universal temporal model. Status 'Accepted'; acceptor unnamed in text.

title: ADR-017 Authoritative Verdict Precedence and Consumer-Path Reach
context: Issue #16: frontend derived session/admissibility from hardcoded sandbox 15-min delay, manufacturing phantom REGULAR_OPEN_DELAY on real-time feed; fix initially fabricated CLOSED_CANONICAL and legacy shortcut overrode admissible:false.
evidence_at_time: Phantom 09:30–09:45 ET window suppressed admissible evidence.
alternatives: synchronizing two truth models (rejected in favor of retiring one)
principal_wording: backend owns provider/session/admissibility/canonicality semantics; the frontend composes and presents them and must not derive them from provider identity.
rationale: Duplicate semantic authority; publishing authority insufficient if local rule governs.
expected_consequences: One authority; composition not invention; authority must reach consumer (consumer-path evidence); strict verdict precedence order; pending fails closed; cache ≠ truth; sealed survives TTL; retire duplicate path; boundary-level tests.
implementation: GET /api/status session block; chains[].admissibility; shared eligibility helper across three engines.
notes: Verification nuance: ingestion hop verified by source inspection, not end-to-end.

snapshot generation/provenance identifiers as recovery mechanism (rejected)

rationale: Anti-hindsight replay requires immutable context and replay-bound consumed values.
expected_consequences: Java/SQLite durable owner; DECIDE stays browser-side; three logical roles (Governed Context Version, Lifecycle Decision Record, Operator Disposition Record); brokerageAccountId partition (opaque client-supplied); bitemporal; resolved values not labels; UNRESOLVED ≠ inactivity; disposition ≠ execution; minimality.
